title: The Palladian Grammar
edition_version: Version of record unless otherwise noted
relevance: A parametric grammar reconstructs main features of Palladio’s villa ground plans. The worked Villa Malcontenta example makes an architectural style explicit as a generative process.
prerequisites: Elementary sets and functions; some proof reading

license_redistribution.conditions: No public redistribution permission verified; citation and lawful reading link only.

locators.locator: pp. 5–8: corpus, eight stages and grid
pp. 9–16: rule stages and Malcontenta example

verification.scope: Primary scan: motivation, eight-stage programme, selected rules and Villa Malcontenta derivation, biaxial extension and discussion. The complete paper was available; selected rules and the argument were reviewed rather than independently executing every derivation. Parametric details are not fully specified in the paper.
